items.title: Roy McCurdy interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: he got myself and Mike Wofford and Brian Bromberg and he just stood up and sang on this album

ctx.x: And that Kenny Rankin thing must have been kind of a change.

Oh yeah, I forgot, we just did that. We just finished that, yeah. Well Kenny’s beautiful. I love the way he sings. And he decided to get away from, not play that much guitar on this album and he got myself and Mike Wofford and Brian Bromberg and he just stood up and sang on this album, it was great. As a matter of fact we went out and did a few dates like that. He’s beautiful.
He does have a unique sounding voice.
